Fail-closed detection-floor extraction CLI (2026-07-19 audit T0.4/T0.6). Runs
:mod:`joulewise.floor_extraction` over one runs root and one extraction spec,
writing a ``joulewise.detection_floor_extraction.v1`` report. Exit codes: *

anchor-shift envelopes); this tool never publishes a claim-bearing floor from
them.
